approved_output.evaluation: Closer to official Emilia than Animagine-only baseline: silver hair, straight bangs, crown braid, violet eyes, pointed ears, white flower and X ornament, purple ribbon, white/lavender costume, cape and green gem are all visible in an independent flower-garden composition. Remaining differences: sleeve ornament detail and some clothing construction are model-dependent.

verification.hardware: NVIDIA CMP 40HX 8192 MiB VRAM, 32 GB RAM

strength_comparison.reason: Strength 1.0 increased canonical costume coverage but produced flatter facial expression and simpler composition; 0.8 retained stronger facial expression, richer scene and more natural overall artwork.

last_optimization: A strength 0.9 full-body test was run and rejected after visual comparison; 0.8 remains the stable identity/aesthetic optimum.

latest_comparison.rejected_reason: The proportion candidate improved full-costume silhouette but one eye drifted pink; the eye-correction candidate still had blue/pink eye drift and flatter expression. The existing 0.8 full-body candidate remains the best combined identity, expression, composition and line quality.

portrait_candidate.evaluation: Best face-focused preset after comparison: symmetric violet anime eyes, silver hair, straight bangs, crown braid, pointed ears, white flower, X ornament, ribbon, cape and green gem. The full-body 0.8 preset remains the main scene preset.

strength_090_comparison.evaluation: Rejected: canonical clothing silhouette became more literal but facial eyes drifted pink/blue and the image lost the richer expression and scene quality of the 0.8 default. Default remains strength 0.8.
